# Pricing

Pick the plan that fits your team.

## Starter
$0 / month. Up to 3 projects.

## Pro
$24 / month per seat, billed monthly. $20 / month per seat billed yearly ($240 per year).

## Business
$49 / month per seat. SAML SSO, audit logs.

All prices in USD. Taxes may apply.

## FAQ
**Is there a free trial?** Yes, Pro and Business come with a 14-day free trial.

# Rate limits

Requests are limited per API key.

| Endpoint | Limit |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /search` | 60 requests per minute |
| `POST /index` | 10 requests per minute |
| `GET /status` | 600 requests per hour |

When you exceed a limit you receive HTTP 429 with a `Retry-After` header in seconds.

Burst: up to 20 extra search requests within any 10 seconds.

search_rpm.instructions: requests per minute allowed for GET /search

index_rpm.instructions: requests per minute allowed for POST /index

error_status.instructions: HTTP status returned when the limit is exceeded

# Incident: elevated error rates in eu-west

**Resolved** · Posted 2 days ago

Between 14:05 and 15:40 UTC, about 3% of API requests in eu-west returned 503. The cause was a misconfigured load balancer rollout. We rolled back at 15:32 and errors stopped by 15:40.

Other regions were not affected.

error_rate_percent.instructions: share of requests that failed, in percent

# Supported platforms

The agent runs on:

- Ubuntu 22.04 and 24.04
- Debian 12
- macOS 14 and later

Windows support is planned but has no date yet.

Minimum hardware: 2 CPU cores and 512 MB of RAM.

# Storage limits

Each workspace includes 10 GB of storage. Individual files can be up to 2 GB. Uploads larger than 100 MB must use the resumable upload API.

Old versions are kept for 30 days on Pro and 365 days on Enterprise.

# Deprecation notice

The v1 Reports API will be turned off on 2027-01-31. Until then it keeps working, but new features ship only in v2.

Announced 2026-08-15. Migration guide: see /docs/reports/v2.

If you need more time, contact support before 2026-12-31.
